qa.question: Should CHP be yes for Spurlock Units 3 and 4?
qa.finding: The 2025 integrated resource plan at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2025-00087/jessica.fitch-snedegar%40ekpc.coop/04012025042343/EKPC_2025_IRP_-_Public_Redacted_Version.pdf names only Units 2 and 1 as the steam sources for the International Paper facility. It does not mention Units 3 and 4.
qa.recommendation: Ask the project manager whether Units 3 and 4 should be changed to no, since no source in this sweep says they supply steam.
qa.note: GEM shows CHP yes on all four units. Only a document that says no would justify a change.

qa.question: Is PJM request C01-1227 at Spurlock a new gas plant?
qa.finding: The PJM cycle request C01-1227 was filed by East Kentucky Power Cooperative, Inc. on April 27, 2026 for 758 MW of natural gas at Spurlock, with service requested by December 31, 2031. It is not any of the four co-firing units, which are existing coal units.
qa.recommendation: Add a new announced gas unit at Spurlock with 758 MW and owner East Kentucky Power Cooperative, citing the PJM cycle request page, unless the project manager knows it duplicates something.
qa.note: The Commission order of July 3, 2025 grants a certificate only for the Cooper combined cycle unit and the co-firing retrofits. The 2025 integrated resource plan names no Spurlock combined cycle. The Spurlock permit record on the Kentucky eSearch site shows pending change APE 2026-7 received September 4, 2026 with no documents online. On the second pass I read the request from the page's own download file, which only answers to a form post. The address https://www.pjm.com/m/ProjectTransition/GenerateXMLTransitionProjectsAll returned 404 to the verifier, so the page could not be verified by a plain fetch.

monitor.monitor_reason: PJM cycle row C01-1227 shows East Kentucky Power Cooperative requesting 758 MW of gas at Spurlock, but no certificate, air permit or county record names it, and the row cannot be fetched by a plain address.
